apps.message:
feat: count the catalog's pages and "open app" clicks, never the apps

## Intent

See whether the apps are used at all, without counting anything inside an app. The catalog is a platform site and counts its visits and how often an app is opened from it.

## Key changes

- The catalog's own layout loads the platform's usage counter (/lernapps-count.js, served by lernapps.github.io), not the shared laHead, and never in a preview.
- The "open app" link counts as the event app/<id>.
- Nothing happens until the counter is turned on in lernapps.github.io.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs the counter script of lernapps.github.io (6a62044). The tooling (e2a59eb) and docs (8ccaaa4) sites load it the same way; ORGANIZATION.md in .github (502dbfe) names the exception.

tooling.reason: The only commit of this request in the tooling.
tooling.message:
feat: count the tooling site's pages; the counter is the one exception to the page rules

## Intent

The tooling site is a platform site and counts its visits. The architecture forbids requests to other servers on every page, so it must name the counter as the one exception; the rules for apps stay as they are.

## Key changes

- The build adds the platform's usage counter (/lernapps-count.js) to the site's pages after lernapps-frame, never in a preview. It is not part of the site frame, so an app never carries it.
- The page rules (con-page-rules) and their evidence name the counter as the one exception for the platform's own sites.
- The app rules (no-tracking, no-request-before-click, the rubric) are unchanged.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs the counter script of lernapps.github.io (6a62044). The catalog (apps ee5555a) and docs (8ccaaa4) load it too; ORGANIZATION.md in .github (502dbfe) names the same exception.

.github.message:
docs: name the platform sites' usage counter as the one exception to the page rules

## Intent

The organisation's rules say no page sends requests to other servers before a click. The platform sites now count their visits, so the rules must name that one exception, and say that apps are never counted.

## Key changes

- ORGANIZATION.md: the platform's own sites (home, catalog, docs, tooling) count their visits as totals with the usage counter, only to see whether the apps are used. It is not part of the site frame, and nothing is counted inside an app.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The same exception is in the tooling's page rules (e2a59eb); the counter itself is in lernapps.github.io (6a62044).
